answer_1.quote: We propose VisFinEval, a multimodal benchmark designed for the Chinese financial domain, which aims to evaluate the capabilities of MLLMs in processing and reasoning across the entire financial business workflow.
answer_1.outputs: The paper describes generating question-answer (QA) pairs based on financial images using MLLMs, including multi-turn dialogues and counterfactual reasoning tasks.

answer_2.quote: We developed an automatic screening process driven by a set of prompts and scoring criteria, including image information density, semantic validity of the QAs, data diversity, objectivity, and computational complexity.

answer_3.quote: Following a similar approach, we designed specific prompts and employed Qwen-max-latest as the judge model to evaluate the outputs of various models.

answer_4.quote: On the human side, we included undergraduate students with no background in finance as representatives of non-experts, while the financial expert role was filled by a PhD candidate majoring in finance.
answer_4.guideline: All participants were uninvolved in any data annotation or review processes related to this study, and all responses were collected under closed-book conditions.
